summary: TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. 12.1 live, S2 opens 08-18, migration owner-pending. Bloodmallet retired MID1. Icy Veins M+ scale-blocked. 26/26 attempted, 2 tier moves.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 210-357 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = tier, entry img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster). RAID: 40/40 re-parsed with ZERO moves against stored. M+ STILL BLOCKED, fourth day: the live M+ pages publish S+ / A+ / B+ / TBD while the `icyveins` scale has five bands carrying neither S+ nor B+, and the live M+ letters remain byte-identical to the icyveins-ptr list on all 39 placed specs (re-verified row by row) - Icy Veins has replaced its live M+ lists with its PTR list. 34 of 40 stored M+ letters would move if the scale allowed a merge (Arcane Mage B->S+, Beast Mastery A+->C, Blood DK C->S, Subtlety Rogue A->TBD). scales.json is the gate contract, so this stays an OWNER ESCALATION and the stored M+ letters are untouched. Era: five of six pages read "Patch 12.1 / Midnight Season 2"; the raid-healer page keeps a 12.0.7 title over a Season-2 body (changelog top line "11 Aug. 2026: Updated for Midnight Season 2 launch"; its 20 other "Season 2" hits are nav chrome) - body over title per the blue-tracker precedent, so seasonVerified stays s2 on all 6, out of the live consensus via the frozen lane and into the next-patch forecast input. published RE-READ per page rather than carried forward: raid DPS/tank + all three M+ 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-06 by JSON-LD - agrees 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Snapshots advanced 08-12 -> 08-13; partial because only the raid half of the source can land.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 217-353 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as this source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40/40 specs read (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) with ZERO tier moves against stored - no rebuild since the 2026-08-09 one, consistent with its Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue is still the literal upstream TBD row and stays an explicit null, never omitted and never guessed (39 rated rows, floor 24). published RE-READ from the page: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three (the in-body "Last UPDATED" line still says 08-02; dateModified wins per the refresh-tiers precedence), agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence. Snapshot advanced 08-12 -> 08-13.

Both pages fetched live, HTTP 200 (150 KB raid / 162 KB M+), parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"). 79 assignments (39 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Era: the pages still self-date "Last Updated 31st March 2026" and contain ZERO occurrences of "12.1" or "Season 2" anywhere, so seasonVerified stays s1 and Method remains one of only two live-season letter sources (with Archon) while Icy Veins and Wowhead sit ahead in s2. Vengeance DH is still absent from the RAID list upstream - omitted, not invented. The rejected alt strings are the eight M+ dungeon names and the site logo, not specs.

All 6 pages fetched with the full browser header set, HTTP 200, 72-328 KB (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Tiers parsed from the embedded [tier-list=rows] BBCode - the block sits inside a JS string, so the closing tag is escaped as [\/tier-list] and a regex anchored on the unescaped form matches nothing. 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. JSON-LD dateModified: all three raid pages 2026-08-08, M+ healer 2026-08-09, M+ tank 2026-08-11, and the M+ DPS page REBUILT TODAY at 2026-08-13 - its stored published advanced 08-08 -> 08-13 (the rebuild moved no letters), and all six agree with published-evidence. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus via the frozen lane, into the next-patch forecast input).

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists[], metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping; spec read from each entry's icon "Class-Spec"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. TWO tier moves, both raid: Discipline Priest S->A and Restoration Druid A->B. Both moved their consensus SCORE without changing a letter (Discipline raid 86->79, Restoration Druid raid 73->67) - Archon is one of only two live-lane sources right now, so a single-source move carries more weight than usual. Archon's lastUpdated reads 2026-08-12T12:00:00Z and this time the numbers behind it DID move (see archon-metrics), unlike yesterday's label-only advance. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 content (the nine S1 bosses, the eight S1 dungeons), so seasonVerified stays s1.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200, 40/40 specs on every encounter = 680 tier rows (floor 440). 23 per-encounter moves, ALL of them raid and concentrated on Salhadaar (11, including Fire Mage A->S and Arms Warrior A->B) with 5 on Chimaerus, 4 on Midnight Falls and singles on Imperator, Crown and Beloren; every M+ per-dungeon tier is byte-identical. data/encounter-tiers.json asOf was set to 2026-08-12, Archon's own cut date, not the run date.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically, not the default popularity grouping): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched. ZERO tiers moved against stored, so nothing was re-merged and spec.survivability keeps asOf 2026-08-11 rather than being re-stamped; the page snapshot this requirement measures advanced on the strength of the full re-parse.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows with n = each spec's parse count. A GENUINE NEW CUT this run, the mirror of yesterday: all 33 values and all parse counts moved (Frost Mage 177412/22611 -> 177498/19239, Unholy DK 173110/20510 -> 173065/17203). Parse counts fell ~15% across the board as Season 1 winds down. Merged at Archon's own cut date 2026-08-12, never the run date. The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, all seven values and parse counts moving with the same 2026-08-12 cut (Restoration Shaman 190071 -> 189876). Merged at Archon's cut date. Emitted as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never be hidden by the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column: 40/40 specs parsed cleanly, and ALL 40 values AND ALL 40 parse counts are byte-identical to stored for the third consecutive run, while the M+ pages' lastUpdated label advanced to 2026-08-12T12:00:00Z. Re-stamping an unchanged cut with a fresher date is exactly the failure the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf rule exists to prevent, so nothing was merged and the rows stay at 2026-08-10 (3 days, maxAgeDays 5). This run also re-proves why the parse-count column, not lastUpdated, is Archon's re-cut detector: the raid half DID re-cut behind the same unchanged label.

80 rows parsed (40 raid + 40 M+) from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100. The RAID half moved with the 2026-08-12 re-cut and was merged at that date; the M+ half is byte-identical to stored and was deliberately left alone rather than re-stamped. The family's coverage date is therefore the unchanged M+ half at 2026-08-10 (the probe takes the 60th-freshest of 80 rows), which is what previousAsOf/newAsOf report and why this is partial rather than success.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, plain curl, HTTP 200, 161 KB. Selected categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined - a WHITELIST, so the melee/ranged subsets cannot double-count the 27 DPS specs - giving exactly 27+7+6 = 40 rows with classSpec names byte-identical to the roster. UPSTREAM HAS NOT RE-RUN: manifest.snapshotDate is still 2026-08-11 (pipeline completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39Z) and all 40 lowerBound values plus all 40 numberOfCharacters are identical to stored at the stored 1-decimal precision, so nothing was merged. asOf is the SOURCE's snapshotDate per the standing rule, never the run date, which is why this is partial at 2 days old (maxAgeDays 8) rather than a success claim.

All three meta pages (dps/healer/tank M+) fetched by plain GET, HTTP 200, 40-71 KB - never r.jina.ai, which does not work on murlok. Parsed by splitting on <a> tags and testing for meta-item anywhere in the tag, because murlok's attribute order is NOT stable (the documented gotcha that silently dropped 4 specs from a class-anchored regex); the tell that it parsed cleanly is that the rank column is contiguous 1..27 / 1..7 / 1..6, and it is. 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, and every one of the 40 "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" values is unchanged from stored - the Season-1 ladder is frozen with the season over. Merged at the run date: murlok publishes no snapshot date of its own, so asOf can only mean the date we observed the value live, which is why this is not the Archon/wowmeta re-stamping problem. Page titles still read "Season 1" while the bodies say "Patch 12.1".

BLOODMALLET HAS RETIRED THE MID1 CHARTS AND THE MID2 SET IS STILL INCOMPLETE - nothing could honestly be ingested. All 27 DPS specs requested from talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 4 retries each: 14 returned charts and EVERY ONE is simc_settings.tier == "MID2", re-simmed 2026-08-12 19:37-19:45 UTC; the other 13 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on all 4 tries, and 12 of those were live MID1 charts yesterday (Havoc + Devourer DH, Balance + Feral Druid, Devastation Evoker, Windwalker Monk, Retribution Paladin, Assassination + Outlaw Rogue, Demonology Warlock, Arms + Fury Warrior; the 13th is Augmentation Evoker, the documented genuine absence). So the stored MID1 pool can no longer be refreshed OR completed, and merging 14 MID2 vectors (~1.7-2.3x the MID1 values) into 12 MID1 ones would make every ST/cleave/AoE label an artifact of which specs upstream has re-simmed, because those labels are within-role percentiles across DPS specs. Nothing was written: the 26 stored profiles stay whole and internally comparable at 2026-07-08 coverage (36 days against maxAgeDays 5 - the red heartbeat is the correct signal). The full MID2 re-harvest remains a one-shot owner action for the 12.1-live migration, now additionally blocked on Bloodmallet publishing the remaining 13 specs.

MID1_Raid.html re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 37.2 MB. Its own header still reads "Timestamp: 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000", SimulationCraft 1205-01 for 12.0.7.68974 (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974) - the same completed report as the last five runs, so there is no re-sim to ingest. Verified rather than assumed: all 26 stored "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" values reproduce EXACTLY out of the DPS-ranking chart's own data block, taking the best variant per spec. PARSE NOTE for the next run: the player-name regex MUST allow a hyphen - MID1_Demon_Hunter_Devourer_Void-Scarred is Devourer DH's best variant at 118341, and a [A-Za-z_]+ pattern silently drops it, scoring the 115175 Annihilator profile instead and looking exactly like upstream drift. 26 rows unchanged at 2026-08-08 (5 days, maxAgeDays 10).

Fetched DIRECTLY, HTTP 200, 187 KB (/period/latest 302s to the period page; r.jina.ai was not needed and its condensed markdown is not trustworthy for per-spec attribution). Still period 1075, MID1, 10000 characters / 3247 unique - no new weekly period, as expected with Season 2 still five days out. 36 spec bars parsed from the "Spec representation in top keys" figure: 34 unchanged and 2 moved (Unholy DK 17.8 -> 17.7, Subtlety Rogue 0.2 -> 0.3), so the page does recompute within a period. BEAST MASTERY HUNTER IS BACK on the page after yesterday's absence, taking the absent set back to four (Vengeance DH, Restoration Druid, Devastation Evoker, Protection Paladin) - legitimate upstream zero-representation absences, not parse misses; their stored rows keep their older dates, which is what keeps the family's coverage date honest.

No new build to log - the feed is unchanged at 15 entries, newest still the 2026-08-06 launch patch notes. All three channels checked. (1) Official thread 2317811.json: posts_count 17, highest_post_number still 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31T23:42Z), nothing new; with 12.1 shipped the thread is effectively closed for this cycle. (2) Wowhead news RSS: 40 items spanning 2026-08-08..08-13, bodies read out of content:encoded in a single fetch. Exactly ONE new class-relevant item - "Class Tuning Roadmap for Midnight Season 2" (news=382435, 08-12 18:34) - and it is a SCHEDULE, not tuning: Season 2 begins August 18 with the first tuning pass that day, then August 25, September 1 and September 22. It carries no per-spec line, so it correctly produces no feed entry and no outlook vote; the rest is live-service (scenario bugs, hero gear, Renown rewards, sparks, housing). (3) Wowhead blue tracker (/blue-tracker?rss with the FULL browser header set - a UA-only fetch is CloudFront-403 and reads as an empty feed): 50 items back to 08-07, whose only class-relevant entries are the same roadmap post mirrored as "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans"; there is NO standalone class-tuning blue post of the Kaivax "Healer Tuning" shape. No tier-set line landed, so no spec.tierSet upkeep was due. Writeup coverage holds at 39/40 - Demonology Warlock's ptr: null stays deliberate ("no changes going to Season 2" is not a verdict), and no writeup was manufactured from tuning lines.

TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. transcript-fetch/summary.json (2026-08-13T11:28:23Z) reports verdict "limit-exceeded" on the single video it attempted (bqVHzvKJCuA), 1 requested / 0 fetched, "remaining queue untouched" - Supadata's free tier is 100 requests per MONTH and the budget is spent. No transcript was readable, so ZERO takes and ZERO metaNotes were added, changed or superseded; this agent fetched nothing from YouTube or any transcript API by any means. DISCOVERY was completed in full: all 44 distinct channels polled (114 class-creator entries plus 3 generalCreators collapse to 44 channels), 44/44 HTTP 200, 0 RSS failures, 660 videos enumerated, diffed against a 955-id seen-set built from structured data only (pending seen[] + skipped[] + videos[], union every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote). 11 unseen videos, ALL inside the 12.1 cycle; the nightly keyword filter was KEPT per the monthly-budget rule and 5 were queued to data/pending-transcripts.json, taking the queue to 20 - Shadarek's "Havoc Demon Hunter 12.1 Raiding & Mythic+ Guide" is the one worth draining first. The 6 not queued are two Critcake stream-title VODs, a Tettles short, a Tactyks mount-giveaway stream, a Shindigg meme short and a Dalaran Gaming PvP-duels video (same format as an already transcript-verified skip); as in previous runs they were deliberately NOT written into seen[], because a nightly budget dismissal must not hide a video from the local unfiltered yt-dlp sweep that reconsiders it. generalCreators[].latest was left unchanged on purpose: those fields hold distilled one-line reads, not bare titles.
